league.signed_out_desc: Join weekly leagues, climb from Wakaba to Fuji and see how you rank. Create a free account to start.

league.hidden_desc: Other learners can't see you and you aren't ranked. Your progress and XP are unaffected.
league.how_1: Every week (Monday 12:00 AM IST to the next Monday) you compete with up to 30 learners in your league.
league.how_2: The top {promote}% move up a stage; the bottom {demote}% move down. Everyone else stays.
league.how_3: You need at least {min} XP in a week to be promoted.
league.how_4: To keep things fair, up to {cap} XP per day counts toward your league.
league.how_5: There are 5 leagues (Wakaba, Take, Ume, Sakura, Fuji) with 3 stages each. Stage III is the entry; Stage I is the top of a league.
league.how_6: Small leagues are topped up with clearly labelled Dojo bots so there is always someone to chase. Bots are never promoted and never shown as real people.
league.privacy_desc: Others see only your username, avatar and XP. Turn this off to leave leagues and all leaderboards.
